protocol.belt_parser: read the belt .xlsx breathing channel; force-belt/displacement column per the dataset's documented layout (to be confirmed from the belt file header on the execution machine; if the respiratory channel cannot be identified deterministically -> REFERENCE_UNUSABLE)
protocol.units: device-native (force/displacement); rate derived, not absolute units
protocol.sample_rate_hz: read from the belt file/metadata; must be > 4x the max respiratory frequency (0.7 Hz)
protocol.missing_value_handling: linear interpolation over gaps < 1 s; longer gaps -> window excluded (RECORDING_DURATION_BELOW_FROZEN_MINIMUM if usable span < 45 s)
protocol.rate_extraction: dominant-peak of the band periodogram over the evaluation window (same band as the estimators); reported in breaths/min
protocol.artefact_criteria: reject windows whose belt band-power SNR is below a frozen floor (belt_sqi_min = 4); such windows -> reference not usable for that window
protocol.edge_handling: Hann window; no windows spanning documented breathing-protocol transitions (normal->fast) are used for the steady-rate comparison

prohibited: choosing the belt channel/filter to minimize radar estimator error
removing difficult windows after viewing candidate outcomes
